items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: I think Sidney Montague was playing drums and I get there.

ctx.x: Can you tell us any more about when you were young, aside from music, anything that you

did to me? Yeah, well I mean I'm not, well I mean money wasn't plentiful like it is now, but you could do more with a dollar. In other words, I remember when I was small, well my little brother, he used to start after we had our little band got together, and my brother studied hard, he went right on, P-ron, you know, and when I was with, played with Riddler and these different bands, P-ron, before he went to P-ron they had a very good young band, about the best young band they ever had, and I don't think they'll…
Is that one they had the picture of, the little picture?
